instructions: Up to 5 days ahead, or up to 2 months for the freezer: mix the turkey with the fennel seeds, garlic powder, paprika, 1 1/2 tsp of the salt and 1/2 tsp of the pepper. Mix with your hands only until there are no streaks left.
Shape the turkey into 8 patties about 1/4 inch thick and 3 1/2 inches wide.

Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the patties in two batches for 3 minutes per side, until deep golden. You're cooking them to 165°F in the middle, so if you have a thermometer, check one there. No thermometer? Cut one open: it's done when there's no pink left. Transfer them to a plate and wipe out the skillet.
Chop 1 1/2 cups of the spinach. Whisk the eggs in a large bowl with the remaining 1/2 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp pepper.

Heat the remaining 1 tbsp oil in the skillet over medium heat. Pour in the eggs and stir often for 3 minutes, until they're barely set. Add the spinach and cook for 1 minute, until the eggs are fully set with no wet shine. Transfer them to a plate.
Split the English muffins and toast them lightly.
Build each sandwich on a muffin bottom: a scoop of cheddar (about 3 tbsp), a patty, about 1/3 cup of the eggs, then the muffin top.
Let the sandwiches cool completely, about 15 minutes. Wrap each one tightly in plastic wrap or foil.
Fridge: keep them for up to 5 days. Freezer: put the wrapped sandwiches in a freezer bag, where they keep for up to 2 months.

In the morning, take off the wrap, put the sandwich on a plate under a damp paper towel and microwave for 1 to 2 minutes (2 to 3 minutes from frozen), until it's hot in the middle. Or thaw it in the fridge overnight and warm it in a 350°F oven for 10 to 15 minutes.
advance_prep_notes: Make the whole batch up to 5 days ahead. They keep 5 days in the fridge or 2 months in the freezer.
method_notes: The Girl on Bloor's freezer-friendly turkey sausage sandwich (4.75 from 4 ratings) is the lead, and nothing read has 20 ratings: homemade fennel and paprika turkey patties, scrambled eggs with spinach, cheddar, English muffins. It is scaled from 6 to 8 sandwiches, and the red pepper, avocado and microgreens are left off because they do not freeze. The Cozy Cook (5 from 1) bakes the eggs in squares instead, with the same 4 day fridge, 3 month freezer storage idea. Fridge 5 days and freezer 2 months come from the lead.
